text: The glass walls and modern furniture suggest an environment designed for collaboration and innovation. Inside, I hear the quiet hum of discussion, interrupted by the soft movements of people arranging chairs. The next space, with bold graphics declaring 'R+D,' radiates an air of curiosity and relentless inquiry. I feel a strange excitement; I am surrounded by the spirit of research and progress, yet the meticulously designed environment makes me slightly self-conscious, aware of being a small part of a larger, purposeful system.
